svg.title: Choosing a sampling design in select_clips()
svg.desc: Three cards match each sampling_mode of select_clips() to the question it answers: top for retraining and calibration, random_detections for false-positive rates, random_recordings for false-positive and false-negative rates. Below, three panels explain how to cap the effort, why top clips underestimate false positives and what follows the review.
